Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2022

Robust Feature Matching under Extreme Viewpoint Changes

Jian Sun1, Alex Kim2, and Priya Nair1

1University of Example  2Institute of Vision

Abstract
We present a robust method for feature matching under extreme viewpoint
changes. Our approach combines geometric verification with learned
descriptors and achieves state-of-the-art results.

Index Terms: feature matching, viewpoint robustness, geometric verification
